Subject: CIO briefing request — exec-level demo availability

Hi Dylan & Neha,

Quick intro — I’m Alex (Head of Platforms at Helix). We’re evaluating vendor options for inference and have a short executive briefing request: our CIO, Javier Morales, wants a 20–30 minute technical exec demo focused on performance at scale and HIPAA/compliance posture. Lina (copied) is helping with scheduling.

Ideal window: Aug 31–Sep 2 in the US-PDT midday (Javier prefers late morning / early afternoon PT). Can your team provide a VP- or Director-level presenter for the first 10–15 minutes and then a technical deep-dive for the CIO? Also would appreciate a one-page architecture slide beforehand.

Thanks — happy to share a short mutual agenda if helpful.

—Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Platforms, Helix Energy
alex.rivera@helixenergy.com

Forwarding Alex’s note — Helix wants a short CIO briefing late next week (Aug 31–Sep 2). They specifically want VP-level presence for the first 10–15 minutes and then a technical lead for the deep-dive. Lina/scheduler are flexible but prefer PT midday.

My proposal: Neha leads the technical deep-dive (she’s got the latency/cost profile), and Vivek or Marissa can open with the executive positioning and contract/next-steps framing. If Neha is tied up we should identify backup. I’ve attached the current deck and the HLX prep checklist.

Suggested time slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-09-01 11:00–11:30 PT (preferred)
- Wed 2026-09-02 12:30–13:00 PT
- Tue 2026-09-01 14:00–14:30 PT (backup)

Please confirm availability and who will lead the VP opening. If we can lock one of these I’ll send a short mutual agenda and ask Alex for attendee list.

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf, HLX-MAP-prep.xlsx

—Dylan

Thanks for the ping. I can absolutely take the technical deep-dive. I have a standing leadership sync on Sep 1 at 11:00 PT that may run long — can we avoid the 11:00 slot for me? If Vivek/Marissa can do the exec intro for 11:00, I can swap in later if needed, but my preference would be Wed 12:30–13:00 PT (Sep 2) to ensure no overlap.

If we must hold Sep 1 11:00, I recommend Vivek opens (he knows the business case and cost breakdown). I’ll prepare a condensed 12-minute technical script and the one-pager Alex asked for by EOD Aug 27.

Also: recommend we include a short backup plan in the invite: "VP or Head of Product will open; CTO or Technical TPM to lead deep-dive" — avoids reschedule if Javier has calendar conflict.

—Neha
